datasets.name: Heart5 / Five States
datasets.endpoint: binary CAD label with incomplete lineage

datasets.name: UCI Heart Disease
datasets.endpoint: angiographic disease label; >50% positive after harmonization
datasets.feature_schema: 13 common clinical features; see upstream record

datasets.name: UCI Heart Failure Clinical Records
datasets.endpoint: death_event by end of available follow-up; no common horizon
datasets.feature_schema: 11 predictors after excluding follow-up time; see data/manifests/uci_heart_failure_519.json
datasets.patient_independence: distinct HF cohort; cross-source patient linkage unavailable

datasets.name: UCI Myocardial Infarction Complications
datasets.endpoint: any recorded lethal outcome (LET_IS > 0) using UCI admission-time predictor set
datasets.patient_independence: UCI record IDs cannot identify participants; cross-source linkage unavailable

datasets.name: Z-Alizadeh Sani
datasets.feature_schema: age, sex and fasting glucose mapped for transfer

datasets.name: AngioCAD
datasets.endpoint: any artery stenosis bin ≥51%; 377/413 labels matched
datasets.feature_schema: age, sex, FBS; FBS unit assumption unresolved

datasets.name: Duke ACATH
datasets.version: repository release; exact version recorded in local manifest
datasets.patient_independence: separate cohort described; individual linkage not established

datasets.name: Mendeley cardiovascular disease 2021
datasets.endpoint: binary cardiovascular label; reference standard/timing unclear
datasets.patient_independence: not a qualifying external cohort; benchmark previously used

datasets.name: Kaggle Cardiovascular Disease 70K
datasets.feature_schema: 12 variables including age, blood pressure and cholesterol
datasets.patient_independence: not compatible/qualified for current CAD validation

datasets.name: Extension of Z-Alizadeh Sani dataset
datasets.endpoint: CAD when at least one of LAD, LCX or RCA is stenotic; exact harmonized boundary requires source review
datasets.feature_schema: ZAS clinical features plus LAD, LCX, RCA and angiography result fields
datasets.patient_independence: No; publisher describes it as an extension of Z-Alizadeh Sani; row linkage not audited

datasets.license: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data License 1.5.0; DUA required
